scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w server --if-present && npm run test:unit -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server --if-present && npm run lint -w client --if-present
